sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Rotocasting Injection and Airbrush Finishing of Vinyl Art Collectibles

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: France-China income tax convention of 30 May 1984, as amended and currently in force; treaty eligibility and applicable provisions depend on the investor and income involved.

France has numerous bilateral income tax treaties and investment agreements. The applicable treaty must be identified by the investor's residence and transaction facts; no single treaty applies to all foreign shareholders.
As an EU Member State, France applies EU trade agreements concluded with third countries. These are not generally substitutes for a bilateral tax treaty or a France-specific investment treaty.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: French Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.561-2, L.561-2-2, L.561-5, L.561-10, L.561-15, and L.561-46 et seq.; implementing provisions include Articles R.561-1 et seq. and R.561-55 et seq. of that Code. Companies must identify and declare beneficial owners to the commercial register under Article L.561-46. The SAS is also subject to the Commercial Code, including Articles L.227-1 et seq. and R.123-54. Access to beneficial-owner information is restricted under the applicable French rules following the CJEU judgment in Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20; competent authorities and obligated entities retain access, and other access is subject to applicable conditions.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate shareholder's certificate of incorporation or current registry extract, with evidence of legal existence and registered office
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or other public authority in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if the issuing country and document qualify; otherwise Consular Legalization, subject to any applicable treaty exemption

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign corporate shareholder's board resolution or equivalent instrument authorizing the French SAS investment and appointing its representative
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate shareholder, executed by authorized signatories; notarization and public authentication as required by the destination authority
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if eligible; otherwise Consular Legalization, subject to any applicable treaty exemption

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of attorney for the French incorporation filing, if a representative signs or files on behalf of a foreign shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Grantor, with notarization where required by the place of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille if eligible; otherwise Consular Legalization, subject to any applicable treaty exemption

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Identity and address evidence for foreign natural-person founders, officers, and beneficial owners, as requested by the bank, registry intermediary, or compliance provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent identity-document or address-document issuer in the person's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Apostille or Consular Legalization only where required for the particular document; certified French translation may be required

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: French obliged entities must apply risk-based customer due diligence, identify beneficial owners, screen for politically exposed persons, and apply enhanced measures where required under CMF Articles L.561-5 and L.561-10 et seq. Screen against applicable UN and EU restrictive measures and French national measures. OFAC screening is not generally a French statutory requirement but may be required by US nexus, counterparties, banks, payment processors, or internal policy. Re-screen at onboarding and on a risk-based ongoing basis; document false-positive resolution and escalation.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); company-name searches are available through INPI databases, including DATA INPI. Trademark clearance should be conducted separately through INPI and relevant EUIPO databases.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The corporate name must be stated in the articles and filed in the French company-register process. French is the official language for public-law filings; foreign-language elements and non-Latin characters should be checked for technical acceptance and accurate transliteration. The legal form or an accepted abbreviation, such as SAS, must appear in company documents and prescribed business communications. Name availability does not confer trademark rights.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banking, credit, insurance, investment-services, regulated-profession, public-authority, and other regulated or misleading designations where use is reserved or requires authorization
Terms implying a public institution, government affiliation, regulated status, or authorization that the company does not possess
Names infringing prior company names, trade names, domain-related rights, or registered trademarks
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: France has no general statutory company-name reservation period or standard name-reservation procedure for a SAS; therefore no reservation validity or extension period applies. Before filing, search INPI company-name and trademark databases and relevant EUIPO records. If a filing is rejected, obtain the written reason, correct the application or supporting evidence, and resubmit through the INPI Guichet unique. For a reviewable administrative decision, use the appeal route and deadline stated in the decision; seek judicial review before the competent court where appropriate. A registry filing rejection is distinct from a dispute over prior private rights, which may require negotiation or court proceedings.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A SAS must have a registered office (siège social) in France. A domiciliation provider may be used if it is legally entitled to provide domiciliation and the company has a compliant domiciliation contract and access to the premises. A virtual office does not satisfy operational, product-safety, employment, tax, customs, or manufacturing-site obligations. Vinyl toy production, finishing, storage, and dispatch should be conducted at premises suitable for those activities and any applicable environmental, workplace, and product-compliance requirements.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: No reliable published percentage is available for unannounced inspections of a newly formed SAS. Risk is activity- and fact-dependent; manufacturing, chemical use, workplace safety, environmental matters, customs, and consumer-product compliance can result in inspections by competent authorities. Do not treat a virtual-office address as evidence of manufacturing substance.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: INPI company-formation filing and mandatory beneficial-owner declaration charges
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI Guichet unique and applicable registry or filing recipients
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative conversion of current French statutory or regulated filing charges; confirm amounts at filing because tariffs and exchange rates can change.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of the incorporation notice in an authorized legal announcements journal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Authorized legal announcements journal in the relevant department
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory per-line or fixed tariff, depending on the applicable notice and department; estimate converted from euros.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French certified translation of foreign corporate records, resolutions, powers of attorney, and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Sworn translator (traducteur assermenté) or qualified translation provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; varies with document volume, language, urgency, and certification requirements.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille or consular legalization of foreign-origin corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent apostille authority or relevant consular and foreign-affairs authorities
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Country-specific official fees and handling charges; no single French tariff applies to documents issued abroad.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: French SAS articles, founder resolutions, beneficial-owner analysis, and incorporation legal review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French corporate counsel or qualified formation provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional market benchmark; scope, foreign-founder complexity, and negotiation affect fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company-name, trademark, and prior-rights clearance searches
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI, EUIPO, and intellectual-property counsel or search provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official database searches may be free or fee-based by service; professional clearance is a market-rate service.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered-office domiciliation for the initial setup period
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Indicative market benchmark; location, services, contract term, and deposit requirements vary.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Founder, officer, and beneficial-owner identity, sanctions, and PEP screening
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; screening depth, number of persons, and monitoring period affect fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Pre-incorporation tax, VAT, payroll, product-compliance, and operating-structure advice
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: French tax adviser, accountant, product-compliance adviser, or counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional market benchmark; excludes laboratory testing, environmental permits, and ongoing accounting.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Book II (Sociétés Commerciales), Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 (SAS provisions); Civil Code Articles 1834-1844-17 (general contract of partnership); Implementing Decree n° 2020-1062 regarding electronic submission to the Registre National du Commerce et des Sociétés (RNCS).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) operated via the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) on the formalities hub Guichet Unique des Formalités Entreprises (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Formulaire M0 (Cerfa n° 16646*01) – Déclaration de constitution de société – submitted electronically through the Guichet Unique with the draft statuts annexed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an SAS under French law. The Articles of Association freely set the share capital; founders may contribute cash, in-kind assets, or industry/irreducible contributions. Paid-in capital must be fully released only for cash contributions subject to a two-year deferral or five-year deferral under conditions set by the Articles; bank escrow (blocage des fonds) is mandatory on the designated French bank account until the Registrar confirms incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the founding shareholders acknowledge the subscribers identified in the Articles of Association, adopt the French Commercial Code provisions governing the Société par Actions Simplifiée, and declare the amount of the share capital as set forth in the certificate of deposit issued by the deposit bank. RESOLVED, that the company takes up its principal registered office at the address stated in the statuts, to be transferred by the President upon publication of the legal notice. RESOLVED, that the shareholders appoint the President and, where applicable, the Director General for the legal duration of the company, granting the President full powers to complete incorporation formalities, open banking accounts, execute the certificate of legal publicity, and publish the incorporation notice in an authorized legal gazette. RESOLVED, that each appointee accepts office and performs all statutory duties effective from the date of registration with the RCS.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Draft and Validate the Articles of Association (Statuts)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders with optional assistance from a French avocat or notaire; no mandatory notarial deed unless real property contribution is made.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the statuts in the French language containing the legal form (SAS), trademark name, registered office address, corporate object (manufacture and wholesale of designer vinyl toys and art collectibles), share capital, share class rights, number of shares, and governance rules (President, examination of social accounts, formal decision procedures). Each shareholder must initial each page and sign the final signature page. Certification of conformity with Article L.227-9 of the French Commercial Code is required for standard SAS statutes.
required_dossiers: Draft Statuts (Articles of Association)
Certificat de dépôt des fonds (bank certificate of deposit) or justificatif of in-kind valuation report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry or billing office raises a deficiency (impôt réciprocité) on the statuts, the founders must issue a rectified version; in-kind contributions in excess of EUR 30,000 must be valued by a Commissaire aux Apports, and the statutory report rectified, with re-filing through the Guichet Unique within 15 days under a new deposit ID.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Share Capital and Execution of the Fund Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French bank (établissement de crédit) located in France holding the funds in escrow; central securities depository not required.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Founders open a restricted corporate capital deposit account and transfer the agreed share capital. The bank issues a certificate of deposit (certificat de dépôt des fonds) evidencing that the capital is held in trust. For in-kind contributions, appoint a Commissaire aux Apports who files the valuation report with the Grefe of the Commercial Court. For cash components exceeding EUR 7,500, a banking attestation binding the funds until RCS registration is mandatory.
required_dossiers: Certificat de dépôt des fonds (dated and signed by the bank)
Leasing or proof of commercial real estate title for registered office if separate
Valuation report of the Commissaire aux Apports (if in-kind)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank fails to release the certificate, auditors may request the provisional form; if the bank certificate expires after 6 months, re-execute the capital subscription. If a notarial deed is required, the notary issues a notarial attestation coercible against the bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Notice (Avis de Constitution) in a Legal Gazette
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French authorized legal journal (Journal d’Annonces Légales – JAL) approved in the department of the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the notice containing the corporate name, legal form (SAS), share capital amount, registered office address, corporate object summary, duration, and details of the President and General Manager, then publish in the chosen JAL. The publisher will issue a certificat de parution (publication certificate) which is mandatory for filing.
required_dossiers: Final Articles of Association (signed)
President's civil identity data
Corporate object statement in the statutory format
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL rejects the notice due to inconsistency with the statuts, correct the draft at no additional cost within 24 hours and re-submit. If the notice fails to appear, request a second insertion and a heightened certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic filing via Guichet Unique (Formalités d’Entreprise)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI) – Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr); the RCS and Grefe execute the formality at registry level after acceptance.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the Guichet Unique, select 'Création d'activité' and form type 'Société par Actions Simplifiée (SAS)', complete the M0 form with the company's identity, managers, shareholders, registered office, authorized corporate purpose, length of business, and declaration of beneficial ownership, then upload the statuts and all supporting documents. The platform performs a complete eligibility check and transmits the dossier to the competent Registry and tax office. Payment of any fees for optional legal publicity services is processed online; the RNCS issues an Extrait Kbis after approval.
required_dossiers: M0 form (electronic)
Certificat de parution in the JAL
Certificat de dépôt des fonds
Articles of Association signed by all shareholders
Declarations on honor (honorableness) of the President and legal representatives that they are not subject to incompatibility, prohibition, or legal incapacity
Copies of valid identification of all managers and shareholders holding natural persons or certified passports
Declaration of beneficial owners (bénéficiaires effectifs)
Consent to exercise non-salaried functions for managers
Reporting of the place of main activity and territorial classification for INSEE
Certified translation in French of any foreign documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: In case of a solicitation of formalities (demande complémentaire), the founder has 15 days to complete the file via the Guichet Unique; if the dossier is formally refused due to a statutory conformity error, the notifier receives a notice of devolution with reasons, and must submit a corrected version within 15 days of the refusal notification; extended to 30 days upon justified request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Registration with RCS and Receipt of the Extrait Kbis
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Grefe du Tribunal de Commerce or Grefe of the civil court in the department of jurisdiction; formally executed by INPI / RNCS at the national level.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Guichet Unique approves the eligibility, the registry receives the electronic file and admits registration of the SAS. The registry delivers the Extrait Kbis being the official corporate existence certificate, including the Registration Number (SIREN), VAT identification number, name, legal form, registered office, and status of the legal representative. The Kbis constitutes official proof against third parties.
required_dossiers: Reference number of pre-registration (Immatriculation Conjointe / dépôt initial)
Proof of identity of the filing agent
Legitimacy certificate generated by Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If registration is refused due to a conflict of name with existing trademarks that raises a court action, the founder may (i) amend the corporate name prior to registry action, or (ii) maintain the name and defend before the court (TGI) against the opposition claim; the registry shall issue a formal rejection letter that can be appealed by a greffe complaint under Article L.123-3 of the Commerce Code.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Filings and OpenBank Account Finalization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: INPI for trademark registration; French Tax Authorities (Direction Générale des Finances Publiques – DGFiP) for VAT and fiscal status; CNIL for cookies and data protection; bank for final operational account.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon receiving the Kbis, instruct the bank to transform the escrow account into the operational current account. Register the company for VAT (NIF and intra-community VAT number is generated automatically by DGFiP after filing). File any derogatory uses of internet data consent requirements at CNIL using GDPR compliant consent-pop design. File the trademark of the brand and product line names at INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle). The entity must also file a Preamble of Accounts (Depliant des Comptes) if required and notify any appointment of statutory auditor if thresholds exceeded.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis
Statutory fiscal identification references (N° TVA intracommunautaire)
Rib of the corporate bank account once operational
CNIL registration proof (if any personal data processing)
Trademark filing receipt at INPI (optional but recommended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VAT or mandate identification delays are observed in the DGFiP portal, directly contact the Spread/Inspectorate of the Gestion Financière with the Kbis; if the CNIL CNIL receives an incomplete process notice, rectify the legal basis declaration; for INPI trademark conflicts, assert priority from the Paris Convention within the 6 months grace period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Direction Régionale de l'Économie, de l'Emploi, du Travail et des Solidarités (DREETS) – Unité Départementale de la Concurrence, de la Consommation et de la Répression des Fraudes, and the French Ministry of Industry for toy safety conformity under Décret n° 2014-1465.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registre d'Exploitant (registered establishment for manufacturing of toys) under Article L.520 and R.523 of the French Consumer Code; permits for classified installations for environmental protection (Installation Classée pour la Protection de l'Environnement – ICPE), regime of Declaration (D) or Autorisation (A) depending on the volume of resin and solvent.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique, Direction Générale de la Prévention des Risques; local delegation via the Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement (DREAL)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: ICPE regime – likely Declaration (D) under Rubrique 2663 (processing of polyurethane resins) or Rubrique 2260 (rotation machines for polymers) if the quantity of resin reached ≥ 1t/year; if the quantity of VOCs used (solvents, varnishes, paints) exceeds the threshold 100 t/year or 1520.15 installation class 'A' (Autorisation), a full Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) is required for permitting. Below thresholds, a registration or prior declaration suffices without formal EIA.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Airborne VOC emissions must comply with Directive 2010/75/UE transposed by Arrêté du 2 février 1998 modified and Arrêté du 30 avril 2013: limit concentration of VOCs in disposal air 110 mgC/Nm3 (for uses < 10 t solvent/year) and total destruction efficiency 98% for recuperation; wastewater discharge must respect the CE standards in ICPE seams: threshold of 10 mg/L for phenols index, 2 g/L for TSS (suspended solids at any point), and for any surfacing containing nickel, comply with the REACH restrictions in European Chemical Agency (ECHA) screening; solvent waste and varbis residues must be stored in sealed containers and disposed by certified waste treatment operator within maximum 2 years, under EU regulation on transboundary movement if treated abroad.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification: application of the Fire Code (Code de l'Intérieur) requiring a self-prevention of fire in Établissements Recevant des Professionnels (ERP) if the warehouse area > 300 m²; for industrial plants, must obtain attestation from the SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours) for conformity of fire-fighting systems, evacuation plans and flammable material storage; structural load inspection: engineer attestation of floor capacity for casting machines and resin modules, if plant load > 500 kg/m²; workplace clearance: DREETS occupational health inspection to Laplace Labor (labor inspectorate), following the decree on workplace rules to ensure extractive ventilation (vitesse d'aspiration > 0.5 m/s at emission point), glass-face protection for airbrushing booths, declaration of premises to the occupational physician (médecine du travail) within 30 days of registration; issuance of the compliance certificate (Certificat de conformité) by a certified bureau de contrôle (SOCOTEC or APAVE).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP); professional tax services are accessed through the official impots.gouv.fr portal. The competent Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE) handles domestic businesses; the Service des impôts des entreprises étrangères (SIEE) handles specified non-established businesses.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A French SAS is generally registered through the formalities single window (Guichet unique des formalités des entreprises), after which a SIREN is assigned by INSEE and tax registration data are transmitted to the DGFiP. The company obtains or activates its professional tax account on impots.gouv.fr and requests a French VAT number from the competent SIE if it makes transactions requiring VAT registration. A foreign entity without a French establishment applies to the SIEE, providing evidence of legal existence, tax residence, activities and, where applicable, a French fiscal representative. A non-EU entity may be required to appoint a fiscal representative unless an applicable mutual-assistance arrangement provides an exemption. EU-established businesses generally do not require a French fiscal representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SAS is ordinarily subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés, IS). Eligible newly formed companies may elect temporary income-tax transparency (impôt sur le revenu, IR) for up to five fiscal years, subject to statutory ownership, activity, age, employee and turnover or balance-sheet conditions. A qualifying family-owned company conducting an eligible commercial, industrial, craft or agricultural activity may have a separate IR option, subject to statutory conditions. France does not provide a US-style check-the-box election; hybrid mismatch rules may deny deductions or impose inclusion or other corrective treatment.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For a France-established business eligible for the domestic small-business VAT exemption (franchise en base), the principal thresholds are generally EUR 85,000 for sales of goods and specified accommodation activities and EUR 37,500 for services, with higher tolerance thresholds generally EUR 93,500 and EUR 41,250, respectively. Thresholds and eligibility depend on activity and applicable current-year rules. A non-established taxable person generally cannot rely on these domestic thresholds for French taxable transactions; registration may be required from the first such transaction, subject to reverse-charge rules and applicable EU schemes. For intra-EU cross-border consumer distance sales, the separate EU-wide EUR 10,000 threshold may apply.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing mandatory domestic B2B electronic invoicing and transaction/payment e-reporting through DGFiP-approved or registered partner platforms. Under the enacted timetable, all affected businesses must be able to receive e-invoices from 1 September 2026; issuance obligations begin on that date for large and intermediate-sized businesses and on 1 September 2027 for small and micro businesses. This is not a general real-time tax-clearance system: invoices are exchanged through the platform framework, with required data transmitted to the tax administration. Applicable format, platform and reporting requirements should be confirmed for the transaction and taxpayer category.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Qualifying exports of goods dispatched or transported from France to a destination outside the EU may be exempt with credit (effectively zero-rated) under the French VAT export rules, provided the supplier can substantiate export and exit from the EU and satisfies the statutory conditions. Intra-EU supplies are governed by separate requirements, including customer VAT identification and proof of transport. Services are not zero-rated merely because the customer is offshore: place-of-supply rules determine whether French VAT applies, and specific exemptions or export-related rules may be relevant.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export customs declaration and MRN, with electronic confirmation of exit from the EU customs territory
Commercial invoice and records identifying the goods, buyer, destination and transaction
Bill of lading, airway bill, courier record or other reliable transport evidence
Proof of payment or other accounting records supporting the transaction; an inward remittance certificate is not a general French statutory prerequisite
Customer VAT identification and transport evidence for qualifying intra-EU supplies, where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France has no general statutory foreign-exchange repatriation deadline for export proceeds. Unsupported or ineligible export exemption may result in assessment of unpaid VAT, late-payment interest and applicable tax surcharges. Deliberate breaches may attract a 40% surcharge; fraudulent conduct may attract an 80% surcharge, subject to statutory conditions. Certain false-invoice or fictitious-transaction cases may attract a 100% surcharge, and specific VAT documentation failures may trigger separate fixed or proportional penalties. Criminal sanctions may apply to tax fraud. Export and transport evidence should be retained for the applicable statutory limitation period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France), exercising treasury statistics, currency convertibility monitoring, and prudential oversight through the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution). The Directeur Général du Trésor (French Treasury) administers foreign exchange and foreign-direct-investment declaration requirements under the Code Monétaire et Financier.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France applies full euro convertibility under Article 63 TFEU. Both current and capital account transactions are liberalized; no exchange permit, quota, or central-bank approval is required for euro/USD or euro/CNY settlement, including dividend and capital profit remittances. Remittance is constrained only by standard French withholding taxes of 30% for non-treaty beneficiaries or reduced rates under double tax agreements (e.g., China-France treaty) and by the parent-subsidiary regime where applicable. A non-resident investor may freely capitalize a newly formed SAS because designer-toy manufacturing (ISIC 3240) is not a strategic sector subject to prior authorization under Decree 2019-1590; however, a statistical FDI declaration to the French Treasury is mandatory for foreign control or thresholds exceeding 10% of capital or voting rights.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: France imposes no statutory export-proceeds surrender, no mandatory conversion ratio, and no compulsory repatriation period. Export receipts may be retained in EUR or foreign currency in France or abroad. Nevertheless, French-resident companies must declare any foreign bank account annually (French Tax Code Art. 1649 A, Form 3916), and all cash or wire transactions exceeding fixed thresholds, especially around EUR 10,000 or suspicious flows, trigger reporting to TRACFIN. The SAS may therefore hold USD or offshore CNY balances from Shopify/Stripe payouts, but banking counterparties will require a documented treasury policy for anti-money-laundering purposes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_regulatory_overlay: The Banque de France and the European Central Bank supervise euro area monetary policy; no exchange controls exist. The ACPR licenses and supervises French credit institutions, and the Free Movement of Capital provisions prohibit restrictions on transfers between France and third countries except for European-level sanctions and FATF-type risk controls.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BNP Paribas SA (BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with multi-currency sub-accounts (EUR, USD, CNY/CNH)
Operational Account and dedicated Capital Deposit Account (Compte Bloqué) for paid-up share capital

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Crédit Agricole - Caisse Régionale d'Île-de-France (or relevant local Fédération)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (Compte Bloqué) and Operational Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: BPCE / Natixis - Banque Populaire & Caisse d'Epargne

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account with International/Non-Resident Owner advisory desk

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium for complementary liquidity utilities; Low for primary treasury mandate. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Revolut Business, Airwallex, Payoneer, Multitude/Pleo) may legally hold funds for the French SAS via an EU/EEA EMI passport (Directive 2009/110/EC), and they offer efficient multi-currency payout rails for Shopify/Stripe proceeds. However, they are not licensed French credit institutions and cannot serve as statutory capital escrow accounts or issue the 'Certificat du Dépositaire' required during RGS incorporation filings. Constraints include foreign IBAN rejection by certain French suppliers, stricter internal AML gating on high-volume flow-through, and no access to French-led CNH or commercial documentary credit facilities. Such EMIs should be limited to sub-ledger receivables collection and small disbursements while all compliance-critical treasury sits in a Tier-1 French bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French Tier-1 banks strongly prefer an in-person AML/KYC interview with the SAS legal representative (Président) and any non-resident beneficial owner. In practice, remote opening is permissible under France's eIDAS-certified digital-identity rules for French-resident signatories, provided the company has verifiable UBO registration (Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs) and financial substance in France. Non-resident directors and foreign shareholders are generally required to complete an in-branch interview or a notarized French consular power-of-attorney in favor of a French-resident agent before accounts are activated. The physical attendance mandate is higher for the dedicated 'Compte Bloqué' where the bank issues the capital deposit certificate; many banks require the signatory to sign the custody deeds physically or via authenticated certified electronic signature.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO tax-resident in, or commercially linked to, a FATF/GAFI grey-listed high-risk jurisdiction (or an opaque multi-layer ownership structure)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: K-bis extract of the SAS; Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs (RBE) certificate; passport/CNI of each UBO; detailed source-of-wealth statement with bank and tax records; CRS/FATCA self-certification forms (Formulaire de Résidence Fiscale); corporate-organizational chart showing unbroken chain to physical persons; audited or pro-forma financial statements of the ultimate parent if applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume cross-border e-commerce flows through Shopify Payments/Stripe during early treasury life, combined with rapid out-payments to Asian manufacturers
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Shopify/Stripe merchant service agreements; monthly payout reconciliation packs; full merchandise catalogue and SKU-level pricing; business-plan narrative confirming ISIC 3240 rotocasting/injection and blind-box merchandising; product sourcing contracts and customs declarations for art resins; AML/CFT internal policy, gap analysis and staff training certificates.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of French economic substance: foreign shareholders, offshore management, domiciliation to a shared virtual-office provider
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: French head-office lease or approved domiciliation contract; employment/payroll documentation for the Président or local statutory representative; French SIREN/SIRET registration and tax identity notice; warehousing/sub-assembly agreement in France or third-party fulfilment contract; French insurance policies covering product liability and business operations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cash-heavy local POS sales and IP-licensing/royalty flows creating TRACFIN-reporting or source-of-funds suspicion
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified POS/EFTPOS terminal settlement reports and daily-Z reconciliation; cash declaration registers; TRACFIN internal alert log with senior-management review; licensing or merchandising agreements with royalty (designer co-brand) analysis; independent accountant's certification of the revenue sourcing; source-of-funds evidence for the original capital contribution.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Non-resident shareholders inject equity by an international SWIFT MT103 transfer to a dedicated 'Compte Bloqué' (capital escrow account) at the Tier-1 French bank; the wire instruction must contain the ISO purpose code for equity capital and a narrative referencing 'Apport au Capital Social de la SAS' and the company K-bis register number. The bank will require the SAS's incorporation deed, UBO declaration, a board or shareholder resolution, CFE FDI statistical filing acknowledgment (for foreign investments exceeding 10% of control), and source-of-funds documentation for the ensuring 8-figure remittance. Dividend or shareholder-loan conversion may be routed via purpose code loan/equity subcodes but must not be mistaken for share capital in the bank's ownership register. FX conversion of inbound USD/CNY to EUR may be executed at the French bank's spot desk after the escrow account is credited, with a formal trade invoice and internal conversion. No pre-authorization is needed for the toy industry, but the French Treasury's simplified notification must be completed within 30 days of the operation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Disbursements to French/EU artists, designers, and finishing studios are settled via SEPA Credit Transfer (or SEPA Instant for sub-100k amounts). For overseas contract manufacturers (typically Chinese rotocasting and injection factories), the primary rails are: (1) SWIFT MT103 plain telegraphic transfer (T/T) in EUR, USD, or offshore CNY/CNH against commercial invoices; (2) Documentary Letter of Credit (UCP600, MT700) issued by the French bank and advised/confirmed through a correspondent (e.g., Bank of China, ICBC, HSBC) for high-value batch orders; (3) occasional cross-border card payouts for sample procurement and e-commerce marketplace fees via Stripe/Shopify. Each transfer is matched to a three-way dossier comprised of the supplier invoice, the air/sea waybill, and the French customs declaration (Déclaration d'Échange de Biens / Export Control System). French Treasury recommendations require the company to maintain a single sub-ledger of trade payments to avoid sanctions mismatch and customs valuation adjustments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: EUR/USD FX Forward (plain vanilla forward) executed with an ACPR-licensed French credit institution
EUR/CNY or EUR/CNH FX Forward via the Chinese bank's Paris correspondent or onshore CNH market
Non-Deliverable Forward (NDF) over EUR/CNY or EUR/USD for balance-sheet hedging when offshore deliverability is constrained
Cross-currency swap (CCS) to convert long-dated USD receivables from North-American blind-box marketplaces into EUR liabilities
Vanilla FX options for contingent trade-cost hedging in EUR/CNY
FX swap (spot/forward combination) for intraday liquidity between USD e-commerce payouts and EUR supplier disbursements

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements, management report and auditor's report (dépôt des comptes annuels)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (Infogreffe)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholders must approve the accounts within six months of fiscal year-end; the approved annual accounts must be lodged with the RCS within one month after approval. For a 31 December fiscal year, approval is due by 30 June and deposit by 31 July.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Court-ordered injunction with astreinte; civil fine up to EUR 1,500, raised to EUR 3,000 on repeated default; persistent non-deposit may lead to court-ordered radiation from the RCS (administrative strike-off).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultat n°2065-SD and liasse fiscale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP) - Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For a fiscal year ending on 31 December, the electronic return must be filed by the second working day after 3 May of the following year. For a non-calendar fiscal year, the filing deadline is generally within three months after the close of the fiscal year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 10% of the total tax due, increased to 40% in cases of bad faith; monthly interest of 0.2% of the tax amount runs from the statutory deadline until payment.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO / register of beneficial owners (RBE) consistency confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de commerce via Infogreffe / RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No standalone annual UBO form is required in a year with no ownership or control change. Any change, including a share transfer, must be declared to the RCS within 30 days of the event; the annual accounts deposit serves as the occasion to confirm that the RBE data remains accurate.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update the RBE within 30 days may trigger a fine of EUR 7,500 for the company and up to EUR 45,000 for deliberate false declarations; repeated default can be treated as a breach of registry integrity and support strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Contribution foncière des entreprises (CFE) — annual local business contribution payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP — Direction des Finances Publiques (local Centre des Finances Publiques)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: The CFE assessment notice is issued in the fourth quarter and payment is generally due by 15 December of the current year. A declaration of change in business premises or operating basis must be filed before the annual assessment date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or incomplete information incurs a 10% late-filing penalty on the taxable rental value plus late-payment interest; enforced collection may add collection costs of 10% of the assessed amount.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: A statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is required when the SAS exceeds two of the three French thresholds: balance sheet total EUR 4,000,000; turnover excluding tax EUR 8,000,000; average number of employees 50. A statutory auditor is also required for the SAS as a parent undertaking when the controlled group exceeds EUR 6,000,000 balance sheet, EUR 12,000,000 turnover, or 100 employees.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général) as codified by ANC Regulation 2016-06. IFRS is mandatory only for consolidated financial statements of groups whose securities are admitted to an EU regulated market; individual SAS accounts must be prepared under French GAAP.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No additional declaration is required in a calendar year without ownership changes. Upon each share transfer or modification of beneficial ownership, the managing president must file the updated RBE with the RCS within 30 days. At the moment of depositing annual accounts, management must verify that the RBE filed with the registry still reflects the current shareholding structure and, if not, correct it before or together with the annual filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors and Managing Officers (Registre des mandataires sociaux)
Minute Book of Shareholders and Board Decisions (Registre des procès-verbaux)
Register of Share Movements / Transfers (Registre des mouvements de titres)

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax rate (impôt sur les sociétés) for FY 2025; reduced 15% rate on the first EUR 38,120 of taxable profit for eligible small and medium-sized enterprises.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Patent Box: 10% effective rate on qualifying net IP royalty income (article 238 CGI-T); Research Tax Credit (CIR): 30% on eligible R&D expenses up to EUR 100M; Innovation Tax Credit (CII): 20% on innovation expenses up to EUR 400,000; SME reduced 15% rate on first EUR 38,120 band; tax loss carryforward is unlimited in time under article 209 CGI but subject to annual cap of EUR 1,000,000 plus 50% of the taxable profit exceeding EUR 1,000,000.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Cerfa n° 2065-SD (annual CIT return) with supporting forms 2050 to 2058-F; must be filed electronically through impots.gouv.fr via EFI/EDI using approved tax software; non-residents use Cerfa n° 2065-NR.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual filing; corporate income tax prepayments (acomptes) are due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September, 15 December and final balance on 15 May for calendar-year taxpayers.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months of the close of the fiscal year; for a 31 December year-end, the electronic return is generally due on the first business day after 1 May; a professional accountant may extend via EDI where eligible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable net turnover from sale of designer blind box toys, vinyl art collectibles, and accessory merchandise; includes export revenues, excludes TVA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a French permanent establishment (PE) of a non-resident company, report only French-source turnover attributable to the PE; attach Form 2065-NR and audited accounts under article 209 B CGI.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exceptional deductions, employee profit-sharing, certain provisions and other deductible charges; include IP amortisation and R&D costs where applicable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only deductible expenses generating a direct economic function in France may be offset against PE income; intra-group charges require arm's-length substance and prior documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax losses carried forward from prior profitable years; specify year-by-year carryforward schedule and the remaining amount subject to the EUR 1,000,000-plus-50% cap.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A French PE may use its own carried-forward losses; losses of the foreign head office or other branch lines cannot be surrendered to France nor taken into account.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total corporate income tax before credits; computed at 25% (or 15% applicable SME band); apply CIR/CII credits and foreign tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident taxpayers must claim treaty reductions or foreign tax credits by completing Form 2069 and, where necessary, the DTA residual credit schedule before the statutory deadline.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: automatic penalty of 10% of tax due, increased to 40% for intentional omission and 80% for abusive conduct; monthly 0.5% late-payment surcharge up to 40%; late-payment interest currently 3.07% per annum; directors who knowingly cause the omission may be jointly and severally liable for the tax arrears and penalties.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% withholding tax for dividends distributed to non-resident corporate shareholders (article 119 bis CGI); 12.8% for non-resident individual shareholders (PFU rate); reduced to 0% under EU Parent-Subsidiary Directive for qualifying EU corporate parents holding at least 5% for 24 months; treaty rates typically 5-15% where applied.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a DTA reduction, obtain a certified certificate of fiscal residency (Formulaire 5000) from the home-state tax authority and file it, with a statement of beneficial ownership, before or at the time of dividend payment. For EU corporate shareholders, complete the simplified dividend withholding declaration (Formulaire 2777/2563) and self-certify the 5% shareholding and holding period to benefit from directive exemption; any excess WHT may be reclaimed by the beneficiary through a restitution claim filed with the DGFiP within the statute of limitations applicable to the treaty (normally three years from 31 December of the payment year).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory withholding at 33.33% for French-source royalty income (Article 182 B CGI), reduced to 0% or 5% under most French DTAs and to 0% under the EU Interest and Royalties Directive for linked EU companies receiving IP royalties; debt interest: general exemption from withholding tax for non-resident corporate lenders, 12.8% withholding for non-resident natural persons, and 75% withholding for recipients in non-cooperative States (SJNC).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Master File/Local File for a French entity with annual turnover or total balance sheet above EUR 400,000,000, or where the entity holds a majority interest in a foreign enterprise and its own turnover/total assets exceed EUR 50,000,000; Country-by-Country Report mandatory for groups with consolidated revenue exceeding EUR 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies the OECD arm's-length standard and the abuse-of-law doctrine (abus de droit); artificial or fictitious arrangements may be recharacterised under LPF Article L.64. The Patent Box and CIR regimes require actual French economic substance, including continuous R&D activity, qualified staff, and management decisions in France; a design-and-manufacturing SAS performing rotocasting, injection moulding and airbrush finishing must demonstrate real production premises, inventory, and active supervision to withstand recharacterisation as a letterbox company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Knowingly omitting sales turnover of designer blind box toys from the annual 2065 return, under-invoicing related-party distributors, or recording fictitious purchases to inflate deductions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal fine up to EUR 500,000 and imprisonment up to 5 years (7 years and EUR 500,000 for organised fraud) under article 1741 CGI; additionally, confiscation of assets, 10-year exclusion from public procurement, publication of the judgment, and loss of certain tax advantages; administrative late-filing penalties up to 80% may apply concurrently.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who personally prepare or sign knowingly fraudulent declarations are criminally liable; civil courts may pierce the corporate veil and impose joint and several recovery of unpaid corporate tax, interest, and penalties against the director, including travel bans under the French tax collection procedure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling toy collectibles below arm's-length price to a captive Hong Kong distributor, paying excessive royalties for a designer-IP licence, or allocating group expenses without economic substance to shift profits outside France.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of profits under article 57 CGI; penalty of 40% on the additional tax if the mispricing was not performed in good faith, or 80% if the arrangement has no actual purpose; late-payment interest at 3.07% per annum; the French tax authority may issue a unilateral TP adjustment and obtain bank account seizure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held personally liable in civil action for the amount of tax evaded if they knowingly engineered the transfer-pricing scheme; criminal prosecution for complicity in tax evasion carries imprisonment, fines, and professional disqualification; travel ban may be imposed to secure the collection.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Abusive Shell Company / Artificial Arrangement (Abus de Droit)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Creating circular intra-group financing through an offshore entity, or transferring IP/patents held for the blind-box characters to a non-resident shell company while all product design, mouldmaking, rotocasting, airbrushing and marketing decisions remain in France.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGFiP is authorised to disregard the artificial transaction under LPF article L.64; the resulting tax saving is subject to an 80% penalty, plus a EUR 10,000 fine where non-genuine transactions are involved; reopening of previous fiscal years and rectification of all downstream profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The managing director of the SAS may be jointly and severally liable for the penalties if the abuse has no purpose but to avoid tax; in serious cases the director's personal assets may be attached after a criminal conviction for tax evasion, and an exit/travel ban can be ordered during judicial investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Extracting profits through unwarranted shareholder loans, excessive advances or non-arm's-length licence fees to avoid the formal dividend withholding-tax process; distributing fictional profits to shareholders from overstated blind-box inventory valuation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recharacterisation of the value transferred as a deemed distribution under article 111 CGI; withholding tax at 25% (or treaty-reduced rate) is reasserted on the grossed-up amount; civil penalties of 80% for deliberate misdeclaration under article 1728 CGI plus late-payment interest; the taxable basis is recalculated with addition of hidden profits.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve or receive disguised distributions are personally liable for restitution, such as repayment of unlawful dividends; in the commercial field, abuse of corporate assets (abus de biens sociaux) under article 241-3 Code de Commerce exposes the director to five years' imprisonment and a EUR 375,000 fine, plus civil liability to the company and creditors; travel ban and provisional arrest may also be ordered.
